title: I Gave My Life for Thee
lyrics: [D7]I [G]gave my [C]life for [G]thee, My precious [A7]blood I [D]shed,
[D7]That [G]thou might'st ransom [C]be, And [G]quickened [D7]from the [G]dead;
[G]I [D]gave, I gave My [G]life [C]for [G]thee, What [D]hast thou [D7]given for [G]Me?
[G]I [D]gave, I gave My [C]life for [G]thee, What [D]hast thou [D7]given for [G]Me?
My Fathers house of light,
My glory circled throne,
I left for earthly night,
For wanderings sad and lone;
I left, I left it all for thee,
Hast thou left aught for Me?
I left, I left it all for thee,
Hast thou left aught for Me?
I suffered much for thee,
more than thy tongue can tell,
Of bitterest agony,
To rescue thee from hell;
I've borne, I've borne it all for thee,
What hast thou borne for Me?
I've borne, I've borne it all for thee,
What hast thou borne for Me?
